cardOverview.overviewText: The Regalia Active is a premium credit card designed for individuals who seek high-end rewards on travel, dining, and lifestyle expenditures. It offers benefits like complimentary lounge access, accelerated reward points, and exclusive concierge services.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
